# Threat model (STRIDE-lite, one page)

The prose is written once; every gate path referenced below is
verified to exist at generation time, so a renamed or deleted gate
fails the K8 gate.

## Assets

1. **Source documents** — uploaded trial balances / PDFs; customer
   financial data, redacted before any corpus use.
2. **Envelopes** — the served financial truth (canonical_bs and the
   assembled statements); integrity is the product.
3. **The journal** — hash-chained event history; the audit trail.
4. **AI keys and spend** — Anthropic/OpenAI credentials and budget.

## Trust boundaries and mitigations

| boundary | threat (STRIDE) | mitigation — the enforcing gate |
|---|---|---|
| **Upload** (user file -> engine) | Tampering / DoS: malformed or adversarial files driving wrong numbers | Typed front-end parsing into the exact-int IR with always-on asserts; deterministic diagnosis (D-codes) instead of silent repair; corpus replay `scripts/corpus_replay.py` and determinism `scripts/verify_determinism.py` pin behavior byte-for-byte |
| **AI egress** (engine -> model APIs) | Info disclosure: customer data leaving; spend abuse; a model mutating truth | Advisory pass is additive-and-never-blocking (V-family); deterministic lanes never construct a client; per-role daily caps in the breaker `src/engine/ai/breaker.py`; roles resolved via the registry `src/engine/ai/models.yaml`; egress probed by `scripts/check_anthropic_probe.py` |
| **Serve** (engine -> FE/API) | Tampering / elevation: bypassing the gateway to read raw snapshots or re-dress statuses | The facts gateway is the one typed reader (I-family); `scripts/check_import_boundary.py` rejects out-of-boundary imports; additive-only envelope guard; status semantics locked |
| **Git / corpus** (what gets committed) | Info disclosure: unredacted customer data in history; repudiation of results | Corpus policy gate `scripts/check_corpus_policy.py`; scrub tooling kept unreachable from runtime `scripts/check_scrub_tooling_unreachable.py`; journal hash chain + verify `scripts/journal_cli.py` makes served history tamper-evident; pack changes linted `scripts/pack_lint.py` and drift-measured `scripts/measure_bs_drift.py` |

Out of scope here: Supabase RLS and billing hardening (tracked in
`CLAUDE.md` §16 and the security-hardening migration), and the
dependency lock/SBOM (Part E owns making the 2026-08-22 httpx
incident class impossible).
